records.title: Does Out-of-Sight Equal Out-of-Mind in CoT Monitorability?
records.reason: This is a monitorability study comparing explicit and latent CoT on math/QA hint-reliance tasks. It discusses lower inference cost as motivation for latent CoT but introduces or measures no new efficiency method; its evidence concerns interpretability limits.

records.title: Geometric Cross-Modal Token Selection for Latency-Constrained Multimodal Token Communication
records.reason: IBS/R-IBS select cross-modal tokens under latency constraints and report simulated VQA/AVQA accuracy gains. The primary setting is token communication with erasure channels, not LLM/VLM decoder inference, so serving applicability is unresolved.

records.title: GradCuit: Credit-Assigned Gradient Flow Enables Robust and Interpretable Test-Time Latent Reasoning
records.reason: GradCuit optimizes latent states at test time through gradients from generated continuation tokens and improves reasoning accuracy across five backbones. It is test-time scaling and likely adds optimization compute; no latency or cost reduction is established.
